hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ts = Get-Date -Format o; $tool = if ($env:TOOL_NAME) { $env:TOOL_NAME } else { 'unknown-tool' }; Add-Content -Path '.github/hooks/tool-executions.log' -Value ('[' + $ts + '] preToolUse tool=' + $tool)"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ts = Get-Date -Format o; $session = if ($env:SESSION_ID) { $env:SESSION_ID } else { 'unknown-session' }; Add-Content -Path '.github/hooks/session-start.log' -Value ('[' + $ts + '] sessionStart session=' + $session)"
